description: For \(S\subseteq A\), the restriction \(f|_S\) allows only inputs from \(S\) and keeps the values of \(f\). This also applies when the output type depends on the input.
signature: Set.domRestrict.{u_1, u_5} {α : Type u_1} {π : α → Type u_5} (s : Set α) (f : (a : α) → π a) (a : ↑s) : π ↑a
